name: @w6w-apps/zerobounce
description: Validate email addresses in real time or in batch, and check credit balance and API usage, via the ZeroBounce v2 API.

w6w.longDescription:
ZeroBounce validates email addresses in real time — checking a single address synchronously (or several at once, in one batch call) and returning a deliverability status (valid, invalid, catch-all, unknown, spamtrap, abuse, do_not_mail) plus trust signals like domain age, MX records, free/disposable/role-based detection, and best-effort name/gender/geolocation hints.

Beyond validation, this app covers account visibility: current credit balance and a date-ranged usage report broken down by result status, so a workflow can check headroom before a bulk run.

A fit for gating a signup flow on a real-looking address, cleaning a list before a send, or filtering risky addresses (spam traps, disposables, role-based mailboxes) out of a marketing list before they cost deliverability.

ZeroBounce's Email Finder, Domain Search, A.I. Scoring, Activity Data and List Evaluator products, and the CSV-file bulk-upload flow (Send File / File Status / Get File / Delete File on a separate bulkapi.zerobounce.net host), are deliberately out of scope for this app — see the README.
